newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Road Builder to buy township developer.
newsitem.headline: Road Builder to buy township developer.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Road Builder (M) Holdings Bhd has proposed to acquire the remaining 30 percent stake in a township developer for 81 million ringgit.

In a statement released on Saturday, Road Builder said the acquisition of the stake in Seremban Two Sdn Bhd will be satisfied by an issue of 6.11 million new Road Builder shares at 13.25 ringgit each.
Seremban Two is developing an integrated commercial and residential township near the existing Seremban town in central Negri Sembilan state.
Shares of Road Builder were suspended on Friday at the company's request pending an announcement. The stock was last traded at 13.00 ringgit.
Road Builder is involved in the construction of privatised toll roads, and commercial and residential property development.
